name: Teach
source:
"In my nyame as Catbeard Teach, today there will be nyo mistakes!"

Based on Edward Teach, who was a notorious English pirate who operated around the West Indies and the eastern coast of the American colonies.

The former captain of the elusive Vinland Pirate Corps. She has a happy-go-lucky personality, never taking anything too seriously. Due to the curse of a certain place, she has turned into the form of a cat.

At the moment, she's ceded the seat of the captain to [url=/c5154]William Kidd[/url], but still participates in all fo their pirate missions. She enjoys silver vine and catnip.

[From [url=http://fruitbatfactory.com/eiyuusenki/char.html#char07c]English official site[/url]]
